title: GSX-R1000R Superbike (Pro Spec)
description: Representing Suzuki's prowess in the Adventure Tourer class, the Suzuki GSX-R1000R Superbike (Pro Spec) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. A 1000cc powerplant pumps out 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
